blocking: Hard rule violation on home page mobile (index-phone-4.jpg): the fixed 'Pause motion' button (.motion-toggle) overlaps and obscures the 'Instagram · @anarevents' link in the footer because the hww-tab scroll-hide block in site.js is skipped on index.html and the footer's bottom padding is cleared before the link text.

fixes.what: Decouple the mobile scroll-hide logic for `.motion-toggle` and the header `.btn` ghosting observer from the `if (tab && panel && backdrop)` guard in `site.js` so they run on `index.html` too, and in `canopy.css` at `@media (max-width:768px)` add `padding-left: 52px` to `main.canopy + .site-footer address` or increase footer bottom padding so the last link never sits behind the 36px button at `left:16px; bottom:16px`.
fixes.why: On index.html `.hww-tab` is absent, so `.motion-toggle` never hides on scroll and directly covers 'Instagram · @anarevents' in index-phone-4.jpg (breaking the hard rule that controls never cover text/links), and the header 'Inquire' button stays solid gold even when the form submit button is on screen.

fixes.what: Remove `assets/img/pom-tree-night-1400.jpg 1400w` from the `srcset` attributes of `pom-tree-night.jpg` (whose intrinsic width is `1125` and which only has `800w` and `1125w` in `index.html`).
fixes.why: Referencing a 1400w candidate for an 1125px-wide source image causes a 404 network error when the browser selects the 1400w candidate on high-DPI displays.

fixes.what: Change `font-display: block` to `font-display: swap` (or `optional`) on both `@font-face` rules.
fixes.why: `font-display: block` can hide all text (FOIT) for up to 3 seconds on slow 3G/mobile connections if the preloaded font takes time to arrive.

fixes.what: Track the velocity-shake `gsap.timeline` instance and kill/clearProps it inside `kill()` (or wrap it inside `ctx.add(...)`).
fixes.why: A velocity shake triggered right before clicking 'Pause motion' is created outside the initial `gsap.context()` execution and will continue animating after motion is paused.
